info.title: glacier
info.description: Unified pure C# .NET 10 LLM command-line application (glacier). High-performance inference with Universal Architecture Matrix (Llama 3, Phi-4, DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen), in-process LoRA fine-tuning (Glacier.Tune), GGUF adapter fusion, in-process SIMD GraphRAG (Glacier.Rag), PagedAttention continuous batching server (Glacier.Serve), autonomous agent runtime (Glacier.Agent), and HuggingFace GGUF model downloader.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ║   <15ms Cold Start | Zero Python/C++ | SIMD AVX-512 | PagedAttention | RAG    ║
